source: Per-file seconds are JUnit testcase setup/call/teardown sums from the 13 Linux test shards of hosted CI run 45003149008 (2026-11-22, commit ababee094, pytest -n 2 --dist=loadfile). Collection and process startup are excluded. Shard pins and totals come from canonical pack_test_shards. Regenerate with: ci_gate.py durations-from-junit. Provisional until the next CI sample: the four split files tests/test_dcf_redesign.py, tests/test_dcf_redesign_refresh.py, tests/test_design_conformance_canonical.py and tests/test_design_conformance_cli.py use local serial JUnit sums scaled by 1.14.
